bio.text: Forrest Dunbar has served in the Alaska Senate for District J since 2023.

Dunbar's legislative biography describes Dunbar as a lifelong Alaskan who has lived in Eagle, Cordova and Anchorage, and lists schooling at American University, the Harvard Kennedy School and Yale Law School.

It lists service as a major in the Army Guard, two terms as chair of the Anchorage Assembly, and earlier work as a Peace Corps volunteer in Kazakhstan and an attorney at the Office of Public Advocacy.
